Shipping MAILING LIST Contact Back to site Heavy Weapon $ 179.00 1 of 2 Select option Select option TWO WEEK BUILD TIME Qty $ 179.00 Add to cart View cart The Heavy Weapon is my two heaviest pedals in one enlcosure! Top row of controls is the classic Blower Box - Low, High, Distortion and Volume. Bottom row is the Dungeon Master - Low, High, Drive and Volume. Each can be run separate or parallel mixed for what is proabably the HEAVIEST effect of all time! Specs: 4.72" x 3.71" x 1.49" 1590BB2 sized enclosure, buffered bypass switching, common 9vdc center negative BOSS style power input. Current draw ?mA. Power supply not included. TESTIMONIALS: "Holy shit !! Unbelievable job on the pedal man , you killed it !! I swear the pedals go together as well as any combo I’ve played , and I’ve played and own too many ...Thanks man great work !! You should put it in some fancy box and sell for $499 🤘🏼" -Barney F. (West Virginia) "That thing is an absolute beast! Much applause for all the harmonic content that comes out of it. Just awesome." -Ben A. (Tennessee) "The Heavy Weapon is a two-headed Cerberus of chug and grime. The chug side has a Bad Mother Fucker wallet. The grime side has brain chunks in its hair. Together they bark in breaths so hot and nasty that the souls down in Hades are content to stay in their holes. Seriously, man. I had a Dungeon Master already, so I knew what that was all about. The Blower Box side was new to me—and rocked my shit. I put it in a chain up against some other boutiquey distortion boxes, and it blew them all away. Engaging both sides, with maybe just a little more of the Blower Box, produces a truly excellent grinding distortion. I say all your pedals are triumphs, but believe me when I say this one stands tall. Primus inter pares!" -Jeremy H. (California) "Dude WTF the heavy weapon is absolutely insane. Love it, can get everything from white stripes to death metal from this thing." -Kevin G.
